sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Determinants as Area/Volume
lecture_lines: The determinant represents signed parallelogram area.
Absolute value equals the geometric area.
Sign indicates the orientation of vectors.
animations: Show a 2D plane with two basis vectors #FF5733.
Animate vectors to form a parallelogram area #33FF57.
Transform area to represent a scaling factor #3357FF.
Highlight final area with a glow effect #FFFF33.

sections.title: Framing the System as Vector Scaling
lecture_lines: System Ax = b is vector scaling.
x, y are scaling factors for a1, a2.
We reach point b by scaling.
animations: Display system Ax=b as a scaling problem #FF5733.
Visualize matrix columns as transformed basis vectors #33FF57.
Show the target vector 'b' on screen #FFFFFF.
Highlight the unknown 'x' as scalar factors #3357FF.
Connect the vectors to the equation Ax=b #FFFF33.

sections.title: Cramer's Rule: The Geometric Swap
lecture_lines: Replace column a1 with b vector.
Ratio of areas gives x scaling.
This geometric swap computes the variable.
Cramer's rule utilizes these area ratios.
animations: Swap column of A with vector b #33FF57.
Show new determinant formed by the swap #FFFFFF.
Highlight the ratio formula for xi #3357FF.
Animate the geometric swap resulting in area #FFFF33.

sections.title: Visual Synthesis & Application
lecture_lines: Zero determinant means vectors are collinear.
Cramer's rule fails for singular matrices.
animations: Show the system solving process visually #33FF57.
